suppress.notes: CVE-2026-33117 is in the Azure Key Vault Keys library (azure-security-keyvault-keys before 4.10.6): a broken authentication-tag check in its local cryptography path. It is listed under the generic "Azure SDK for Java" CPE with versionEndExcluding 4.10.6, so every other Azure SDK jar with a lower version number matches (here azure-core, azure-identity, azure-json and friends), although none of them contains that code. Key Vault Keys is not in our dependency tree. The package pattern excludes it on purpose, so the CVE still alerts if it is ever added. Reviewed for the-harry-list, which uses the same Azure SDK jars.

CVE-2020-29582 is the insecure temp-file permissions in kotlin.io createTempDir/createTempFile, fixed in Kotlin 1.4.21. kotlin-stdlib-common arrives transitively (microsoft-graph, okhttp 4, okio 3.6.0) at 1.9.10, which is past the fix, and the jar holds only .kotlin_metadata descriptors with no .class files, so it contains none of the affected JVM code. The match comes from the generic JetBrains Kotlin CPE. Scoped to this one jar, so the other Kotlin jars still alert.
